result.ownerWords: Forty is the most anyone goes in a week, Monday to Sunday. I'd rather be short a body than have someone burn out.

result.title: Minimum 11 hours between shifts
result.ownerWords: Anyone who finishes a shift needs at least eleven hours before their next one starts. Ten hours is too short, and I'd rather be short on the floor than have someone come in exhausted.

violations.message: Tom Kavanagh would have only 10 hours between finishing on Thursday and starting on Friday. Your minimum is 11 hours.

result.title: Minimum staff while open, three on Saturday mornings
result.ownerWords: Never fewer than two people on the floor the whole time we're open, kitchen counts too. Saturday eight to noon is the rush, so three in, every Saturday.

violations.message: On Wednesday 28 October, from 7 am to 12:30 pm, Only one person is on duty. Your minimum for that time is two people.

result.title: Coffee machine cover, every open hour
result.ownerWords: Someone trained on the coffee machine has to be on the whole time we're open, seven in the morning till eight at night, with no gaps. Not even on a quiet afternoon or when someone's off sick.

result.title: Never roster someone on a day they've said they can't work
result.ownerWords: If someone's told me they can't do a day, they don't go on it, not even for an hour. No 'just this once'. Regular or one-off, same rule.

result.title: Share weekend shifts fairly
result.ownerWords: Nobody should be stuck carrying most of the weekends while others get none. If someone's done a lot lately, they get a break. Someone who asks for extra weekends themselves is fine, but I still keep an eye on the total.
